title: Design history: wireframes, V2/V7 working builds and the design-system UI kit
note: Real artifacts only, from one fresh clone with each historical commit checked out or extracted. Only the real UI was driven (clicks, selects, typing). No source edits, injected state, CSS changes or annotations. The wireframes are static HTML opened through file://. The V2/V7 builds ran on their own Vite dev servers after npm ci. The UI kit was served by a plain static file server.
